title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Tea Party on 1969-12-30
lineage: SBD > MC > C > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Rough‑sounding but solid recording captures a long, jam‑heavy set with a smoking Dark Star, intense Black Peter and superb transitions like Eleven → Alligator.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its extended second‑half jams, standout performances of Dark Star, Black Peter, New Speedway Boogie and the seamless Eleven→Alligator sequence. Recording quality is generally good but a bit rough around the edges with some EQ quirks and occasional bad cuts. Overall fans view this as a high‑energy highlight of the run.

ai_rating.rationale: Five detailed reviews are largely positive (average 4.4 stars). Show performance is highlighted as exceptional, while recording quality is noted as good but slightly rough, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally solid and clear, but some reviewers note a rough EQ, occasional bad cuts, and the need to tweak settings for optimal listening.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long winding jams dominate the second half, with especially tight transitions (e.g., Eleven → Alligator → Caution). The set builds energy and maintains a high‑groove momentum throughout.
